name: Usui Masaya
source:
Dreamy asocial type.
Reason for wanting to die: Cannot become a hero.
Lingering attachment to this world: Nothing in particular.

A high-school senior with a behaviour like that of a small animal. For better or for worse he has an innocent personality uncharacteristic for his age, and a strong sense of justice. He values love and peace, and adores delicious food to the point of being considered a glutton. 

He has some extreme views and his outlook on life is kind of philosophical, but has a strong sense of responsibility. Most of the time he seems to be in a daze and this makes people think that his mind wanders through another dimension. Most likely an empath as the views of others can often grow on him and become his own.

Lives with his single father after having separated from his mother and younger brother.

[Adapted from [url=http://clubsuicide.net]the official website[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/_MORPATH?s=20&t=j3Xffhv5h-Yo19sJry3tvA]Twitter[/url].]
